summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.56/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.56 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 1, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ lower than a week ago, 51¢ lower than a month ago, and 66¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Racine ($3.39) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.89).
